{
  "phoneNote": "The opening is readable and direct, but workshop photos arrive too late and remain tiny beside narrow, awkwardly wrapped service text.",
  "desktopNote": "The bold typography is clear, but small photos, an unbalanced two-plus-one service grid and large empty areas make the page feel under-designed.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Bring a substantial workshop or mechanic photo into the opening composition, keeping the headline and call action visible on phones.",
    "Redesign the service cards as three balanced desktop columns and full-width image-over-text cards on phones, eliminating the narrow text columns and excessive word breaks.",
    "Consolidate repeated contact details into one main location section with a compact footer, and shrink the unloaded map panel to remove its large empty area."
  ]
}
